definitions.gloss: prohibited for use; use forbidden; out of service
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is officially forbidden from being used. Commonly seen on signs for facilities, equipment, and areas that are off-limits.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使用禁止|しようきんし}です。
examples.english: This restroom is out of service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧{使用禁止|しようきんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧。
examples.english: An area where mobile phone use is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {安全上|あんぜんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{遊具|ゆうぐ}→遊具：17538_yuugu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当面|とうめん}→当面：07579_toumen⟧{使用禁止|しようきんし}となります。
examples.english: For safety reasons, this playground equipment will be prohibited from use for the time being.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧ (use) and ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition). Functions as a no-adjective and is extremely common on signs and notices in public spaces.

USAGE:
One of the most frequently encountered sign phrases in Japan, posted on restrooms, elevators, equipment, swimming pools, and more. Often stands alone as a sign without any additional text. Can indicate either a permanent prohibition or a temporary closure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使用禁止|しようきんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{張|は}り{紙|がみ}→張り紙：15340_harigami⟧ — a sign reading "use prohibited"
- {使用禁止|しようきんし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to become prohibited for use
- {使用禁止|しようきんし}⟦{区域|くいき}→区域：00251_kuiki⟧ — prohibited area

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- ⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧ — no entry; keep out
- ⟦{撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}→撮影禁止：26565_satsueikinshi⟧ — no photography
- ⟦{駐車禁止|ちゅうしゃきんし}→駐車禁止：09691_chuushakinshi⟧ — no parking
- {飲食禁止|いんしょくきんし} — no eating or drinking
